main_measure.name: top-quintile minus neutral mean forward 5-bar return
main_measure.threshold: excess return above 0 with t of at least 2, positive in at least 2 of the 3 coins

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation forecast vs forward 5-bar return (positive forecasts)

decided_by: Inconclusive: positive excess return with t below 2, or coins disagree beyond the confirm/reject rules.
reading: Top quintile is set per coin as forecast at or above the 80th percentile of that coin's positive forecasts over all its rows and windows; the forward 5-bar returns are taken on the per-window grid 0,5,10,... (as is the supporting correlation); and because only 2 of the plan's 3 coins are in the record, the 'at least 2 coins' rules are applied to the coins present.
